answer: A stake-bonded reputation registry makes each agent lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so spawning a nebula of fake identities costs real capital per clone. Honest agents earn a pearl of trust over time as completed work and verified attestations accumulate, while fresh accounts start with no standing. Slashing the bond when fraud is proven turns the jade of cheap Sybil farming into an expensive loss, because every fake identity pays upfront and risks forfeiture.
